fusions.name: Slipped Blade
fusions.desc: Throws a hidden crescent that deals 4 damage and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Its first hit on an unwounded target has 40% more critical chance.

fusions.name: From the Sleeve
fusions.desc: A concealed strike that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Whetted Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Off-Hand Answer
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
